paragraphs.source_en: Matsudaira Hirotada sat in his chamber and summoned the woman he had heard about to massage his lower back. After returning to the inner quarters, the liquor suddenly surged through him, stilling his cough and warming him from chest to waist. His eyes half closed and his mind adrift, the fingers moving over his body made him think of Odai once more.

paragraphs.source_en: In only a few years, Odai had become a part of Hirotada himself. Only after they parted did he feel the full anguish of it. It was not merely as if he had lost an arm; it seemed someone had torn out all his innards.

paragraphs.source_en: There was, of course, his concubine Aku.
